main.description: Replace one of the requester's private audiences, if its version token is still swapCid. Any mode may replace any other. createdAt stays as created. A member taken off stops reading the audience's posts at the next request, and a member added starts. Requires auth by a ready community member.

record.description: A tools.kryphocron.policy.audience record, checked as createAudience checks it.

swapCid.description: The token last read for this audience.

cid.description: The new opaque version token for updateAudience's swapCid, not a CID.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The input is not an object, uri is not one of the requester's audiences (decided from the URI alone), swapCid is not a string, or the record fails a check.

errors.name: InvalidSwap
errors.description: swapCid does not match the stored token, or the audience no longer exists.

errors.name: NotEnrolled
errors.description: The caller is not a community member of this AppView.

errors.name: NotReady
errors.description: The caller's account indexing is still in progress.

errors.name: Reindexing
errors.description: The caller's account is being re-indexed after an interruption; retry after `retryAfter` seconds (in the body; also the Retry-After header). Not NotReady: the caller is still a member.
